title: [ 숙제 ]  식당별 평균 음식 주문 금액과 주문자의 평균 연령을 기반으 Segmentation 하기
markdown: ### [ 숙제 ] 식당별 평균 음식 주문 금액과 주문자의 평균 연령을 기반으 Segmentation 하기 --- > ✏️ > > - 테이블: 주문, 고객 > > - 컬럼: restaurant_name, price, quantity, age > > - 조건 > - 평균 음식 주문 금액 기준: 5,000 / 10,000 / 30,000 / 30,000 초과 > > - 평균 연령: ~ 20대 / 30대 / 40대 / 50대 이상 > > - 그룹: > > - 함수(수식): avg ### 강의 풀이 SQL ```sql select restaurant_name, case when price <=5000 then 'price_group1' when price >5000 and price <=10000 then 'price_group2' when price >10000 and price <=30000 then 'price_group3' when price >30000 then 'price_group4' end price_group, case when age <30 then 'age_group1' when age between 30 and 39 then 'age_group2' when age between 40 and 49 then 'age_group3' else 'age_group4' end age_group from ( select a.restaurant_name, avg(price) price, avg(age) age from food_orders a inner join customers b on a.customer_id=b.customer_id group by 1 ) t ``` 실행 결과 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1baeda9b-0fe1-80ea-8ce4-e564920cc8b3/5896d1998b6cfb22.webp) ### 내풀이 SQL Query ```sql SELECT restaurant_name, price_group, age_group FROM ( SELECT restaurant_name, case when average_price < 5000 then 'price_group1' when average_price between 5000 and 9999 then 'price_group2' when average_price between 10000 and 29999 then 'price_group3' else 'price_group4' end price_group, case when average_age < 20 then 'age_group1' when average_age between 20 and 29 then 'age_group2' when average_age between 30 and 39 then 'age_group3' when average_age between 40 and 49 then 'age_group4' else 'age_group4' end age_group FROM ( SELECT restaurant_name, avg(f.price) average_price, avg(c.age) average_age FROM food_orders f left join customers c on f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY restaurant_name ) a ) b ``` 실행 결과 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/fc1a496aabc930cad33c0d4b5cf3aa52c36a6efc/posts/1baeda9b-0fe1-80ea-8ce4-e564920cc8b3/f5197be4ad5c4e45.webp)
